rules.label: One With Your Weapon (no alternate effect ↓)

automation.notes: Automatic: when you attack with an alternate effect of a weapon that has both the Silent and Martial Arts traits, that effect's own ↓ is dropped, so it never appears in the Downshift count of your Roll Options Dialog. Actions panel: when you pay for Draw Weapon, you're asked whether you're switching between Silent Martial Arts weapons; answering yes makes it a Free action.

source.book: Factions in Action Vol 2: Intercontinental Adventures
